chunks: And the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said:
"Whoever comes to the Jumu'ah with faith and seeking reward, he resumes his deeds anew."
ai.seo_question: What is the reward for attending Jumu'ah prayer with faith and sincerity?
ai.summary: This hadith emphasizes the spiritual merit of attending the Jumu'ah prayer with sincere faith and seeking reward from Allah. It indicates that such attendance brings a renewal of one's deeds, showing the great virtue of this act of worship.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1260 - The Messenger of Allah (sw) said:
"Whoever attends the Jumu’ah prayer with faith and seeking the reward (from Allah (swt)), his deeds will be renewed”.
